metrics.name: API-Only User Count
metrics.gotcha: Users[].api_only is BOOLEAN (confirmed: false on Users[0]). Use backtick-quoted boolean literal.

metrics.name: Legacy Network Count
metrics.gotcha: is_legacy field confirmed in Networks[] structure. Type assumed boolean based on naming convention but not explicitly EVALUATE-confirmed. If filter returns unexpected results, also try == 'true' (string) as a fallback.

metrics.name: Network Count
metrics.gotcha: Networks[] fields include: id, name, is_fcc, role_id, latitude, is_legacy, longitude, new_nodes, account_id, network_id, node_count (integer), spare_nodes, down_gateway (integer — NOT boolean), down_repeater, networkgroup_id, networkgroup_name, latest_firmware_version, oldest_firmware_version, latest_firmware_version_full, oldest_firmware_version_full.

metrics.name: Network Inventory
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Networks[].{name: name, networkgroup_name: networkgroup_name, is_legacy: is_legacy, node_count: node_count, new_nodes: new_nodes, down_gateway: down_gateway, down_repeater: down_repeater, latest_firmware_version: latest_firmware_version, latest_firmware_version_full: latest_firmware_version_full, oldest_firmware_version: oldest_firmware_version, spare_nodes: spare_nodes}
metrics.gotcha: down_gateway is INTEGER (0=up, non-zero=down) — NOT boolean. All field names confirmed in structure.

metrics.name: Networks With Down Gateway Count
metrics.gotcha: CRITICAL: down_gateway is INTEGER (0=no issue, non-zero=down), NOT boolean. Use `> \`0\`` not `== \`true\``. Confirmed via EVALUATE: Networks[0].down_gateway = 0 (integer) and filter returned 0 on demo (all networks healthy).

metrics.name: Total Node Count
metrics.gotcha: Networks[].node_count is INTEGER. JMESPath sum() over the projection should work; not directly EVALUATE-tested. Confirmed node_count = 1 on Networks[0].

metrics.name: User Count
metrics.gotcha: Users[] fields include: name, email, notes, alerts, created, role_id, user_id, api_only (boolean — false=human, true=service/API account), verified (boolean).

metrics.name: User Inventory
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Users[].{name: name, email: email, role_id: role_id, verified: verified, api_only: api_only}
metrics.gotcha: api_only is BOOLEAN. verified is BOOLEAN. All field names confirmed in structure.
